title: Iron Maw. A tale of trains, guns, and corporate rule.
author: crumbaker
selftext:
The game is a mix of a 3rd person shooter on rails, a survivor-like, and a dash of tower defense. You upgrade your rail cars as you go along that assist you in defending the last cities free of corporate rule. Features Co-op where your friend can control the back engine once unlocked. Steam page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5311750/Iron\_Maw/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5311750/Iron_Maw/?beta=0)

I started on this once Astra was released. It took a small books worth of prompting to get what you see here. I'm on the $100 plan and luckily had a lot of banked resets. As far as tips go on how to make something like this. I'd say you start off making a character model, then use a screenshot for the basic environment. Combine those into a basic level then branch out from there. Being super specific about everything helps a ton. The models were all designed via the blender mcp.
